title: LA City General Fund postings, June 2026 vs June 2025

attempts.text: The June 2026 General Fund postings, compared with the June 2025 figures, show a decrease of 5.3% in the year-over-year comparison. The Fire department's posting decreased by $39.3 million, while the Non-Departmental - Capital Finance Administration's posting decreased by $25.3 million. The largest movers (by size of change) are Fire and Non-Departmental - Capital Finance Administration, with Fire's posting decreasing by $46.8 million, and Non-Departmental - Capital Finance Administration's posting decreasing by $25.3 million.

final_text: General Fund postings were $706.8m in June 2026, down 5.3% from $746.1m in June 2025. Year-to-date postings were $9.66bn, up 1.1%. The largest movements were: Fire increased by $36.1m; Non-Departmental - Capital Finance Administration decreased by $25.3m; Police decreased by $20.5m.
